name: managing-orca-plugins
description: Audits, installs, pins, approves, updates and removes third-party Orca plugins (orca-plugin.json, the Orca plugin catalog, Git URL installs and development folders), including trusted-worker plugins that reach Orca's runtime socket. Use before installing, enabling, approving or updating any Orca plugin, when asked whether an Orca plugin is safe, and when reviewing Orca plugin updates. For writing an Orca plugin, use Orca's own orca-plugin-authoring guide instead.
